status: Prospectively frozen before new learned candidate scoring and before inspecting postprocess-v5 observed-test results
hypothesis: Five-second transfer validation peaked after one epoch. Slower steps, dropout and weight decay may improve learned representations' generalization; equal-seed ensembles may reduce initialization variance.
inputs: Complete private authentic five-second caches produced by postprocess-v5; retain original 29/10/10 recording split, soft labels, unknown-class masks, native 32 kHz encoder identity and source hashes
reference_replay_guard: Original saved five-second checkpoint must recover validation AP 0.47008825693046674 within 0.0001 on regenerated caches before any training

training.normalization: Train features only, standard deviation floor 0.01
training.checkpoint_selection: Best supported-class validation macro AP for each seed
training.augmentation: Only training-time hidden dropout; no claim of waveform augmentation or encoder fine-tuning

selection_stage1: For each configuration average the three seed probabilities equally, without choosing a favorable seed. Select configuration by ensemble supported-class validation macro AP. Report each seed's AP plus mean/std and all histories; ties retain earlier control.
selection_stage2: On chosen configuration's equal-seed ensemble compare no filtering, centered 3-second and centered 5-second box filters. Preserve records/gaps/masks and disclose added future context.
selection_stage3: Combine the selected learned policy and prior postprocess-v5 policy using fixed learned weights 0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1. Select by validation AP, retain prior policy unless gain exceeds 0.0001. Any linear-policy flattening must recover prior outputs within 0.000001 and prior AP within 0.0001 before scoring.
thresholds: Validation F1 grid only, after final AP policy; zero-positive validation classes retain 0.5
test: The old test is observed. Load its labels only after final configuration/filter/mixing policy and checkpoint are immutable. Report all outcomes, including micro/per-class regressions; no test-guided next hypothesis.
compute: User removed artificial GPU cap. Use free private Kaggle GPU as available, no paid compute. Record service quota as unavailable if CLI cannot expose it. Fail without GPU, on invalid source contracts, nonfinite loss or malformed checkpoints. Stop each fit on validation plateau; no arbitrary wallclock timer.
confounders: Three-seed deployment versus prior single-seed model is an ensemble-size change
Repeated same small validation set creates selection optimism

Rare classes have missing or extremely thin supervision; weighting cannot invent positives
Existing observed test cannot become independent

next_decision: Review validation curves and failures after this controlled learned round. Encoder fine-tuning or data augmentation needs a separate validation-motivated protocol; neither is claimed by these frozen-head experiments.
